pr_title: infra(deploy): remove || true tolerance, add fail-fast, add Cache-Control header (LP-0.1.3)

findings.title: Consider adding timeouts for Firebase deploy commands
findings.description: While the fail-fast approach is excellent, consider adding timeout protection to prevent hung deploys from blocking the workflow indefinitely. GitHub Actions has a default job timeout of 360 minutes.
findings.suggested_fix: Wrap critical deploy commands with `timeout 10m` or `timeout 15m`

findings.title: Verify that the build system hashes entry point JS/CSS files, not just chunks
findings.description: Vite's default configuration hashes dependency chunks (e.g., `main-abc123.js`) but does NOT hash entry files (e.g., `index.js`). Your firebase.json pattern `**/*.@(js|css)` catches both hashed and unhashed files. If entry files aren't hashed, applying immutable cache with 1-year max-age will prevent users from receiving updates.
suggested_fixes: Configure Vite to hash all files including entry points by setting `entryFileNames` in `build.rollupOptions.output`
Separate your cache headers to only apply immutable cache to versioned chunks (e.g., `**/*-[hash].js`)
